name: 劉琦允
objective:
本課程介紹統計學與機率論的基本概念，包括敘述統計、機率、隨機變數、常見機率分配、抽樣分配，以及基本推論方法。學生將學習如何整理、描述、分析資料，並理解統計方法在實際問題中的應用。
This course introduces fundamental concepts in statistics and probability, including descriptive statistics, probability, random variables, common probability distributions, sampling distributions, and basic inference. Students will learn to organize, describe, and analyze data, and understand applications of statistical methods.
課程進度(1-16週):
Chapter 1: Introduction to Statistics and Probability
Chapter 2: Measures of Central Tendency
Chapter 3: Measures of Dispersion
Chapter 4: Skewness and Kurtosis
Chapter 5: Fundamentals of Probability
Chapter 6: Conditional Probability and Independence
Chapter 7: Random Variables
Chapter 8: Midterm Examination
Chapter 9: Joint and Marginal Distributions
Chapter 10: Special Discrete Distributions
Chapter 11: Normal Distribution
Chapter 12: Sampling Distributions
Chapter 13: Chi-square, t, and F Distributions
Chapter 14: Gamma Distribution
Chapter 15: Linear Transformations and Subscores
Chapter 16: Final Examination or Final Project Presentation

類別
